items.title: 恢复 convergence_check 与 gap_analyze 的 CLI 注册和可见性
items.context: 当前终端里的 koala help 不列出 convergence_check / gap_analyze，但源码里 checkConvergence 仍在 tasks/gap-analyze.ts，MCP dist 也还暴露这两个工具。需要把这两个命令重新接回当前 cli-engine/registry 路径，让 CLI 层和底层实现重新对齐。

happy.desc: koala help 会重新列出 gap_analyze 与 convergence_check，且在普通项目根直接执行命令时不再报未知命令。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:4 WHY test_story proved default koala help and direct convergence_check execution are both live again, eliminating the user-facing unknown-command break. severity=low

edge.desc: 恢复后的命令会继续复用现有 analyzeGap/checkConvergence 逻辑，返回 checks/gaps 这类核心结构，而不是一个临时占位字符串。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:19 WHY test_story proved gap_analyze still returns structured coveragePercent/gaps output instead of a placeholder string. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果只补了 help 没补 handler 注册，黑盒验证会直接暴露 handler not found，而不是假装命令已恢复。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:35 WHY test_story proved convergence_check is wired to a real handler, not just listed in help, because no handler/unknown-command error surfaced. severity=medium

items.title: 补命令帮助与最小回归验证，防止再次出现接口分裂
items.context: 不仅要让命令能跑，还要保证 koala help / phase tools / 最小验证脚本都看得到它们，避免之后继续出现提示文案引用一个不存在的 CLI 命令。
relatedDocs: AGENTS.md#用户价值验收（优先于技术链路验证）

happy.desc: 新增的最小验证脚本会同时检查 koala help 可见性和 convergence_check 实际可执行性，避免接口再次分裂。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:51 WHY the end-to-end verifier script passed, covering help visibility and direct command execution in one black-box path. severity=low

edge.desc: help 文案与 phase tools 对齐后，用户在默认 CLI 环境里能看到正确的 Gap 分组命令，而不是只有文档提到。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:66 WHY test_story confirmed the default help output now exposes the Gap group and both commands, matching user expectations. severity=low

adversarial.desc: 如果未来有人再次把 gap/convergence 从 MAIN_TOOLS 或 registry 漏掉，回归验证会失败而不是等用户在 DONE 阶段手工撞到。

results.note: packages/main/tests/fixtures/gap-cli-commands.json:83 WHY the npm-level regression script passed, so a future MAIN_TOOLS/registry disconnect will fail fast in CI instead of at DONE time. severity=medium
